description: Delete a WordPress post. Call it WITHOUT confirm first: nothing is deleted and you get a sentence naming the post to show the user. By default it goes to WordPress's TRASH (restorable from Posts > Trash); permanent:true skips the trash and cannot be undone. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed to the sentence the first call returned

permanent.description: skip the trash — cannot be undone

name: delete_wordpress_post
title: Delete a WordPress post
